globalNews.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
globalNews.summary: The announcement came after Russian President Vladimir Putin met US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg.

globalNews.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
globalNews.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

globalNews.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
globalNews.summary: Her alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday.

globalNews.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
globalNews.summary: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

globalNews.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
globalNews.summary: Faheem Akram allegedly sold more than 5 million fake postage labels for a fixed price of $2 a piece.

cryptoNews.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
cryptoNews.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.

cryptoNews.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
cryptoNews.summary: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”

cryptoNews.title: Chainlink, Cardano, other blockchain groups push SEC for clearer crypto rules
cryptoNews.summary: Six major blockchain organizations urged the SEC to formally recognize digital commodities as non-securities in its proposed regulatory framework.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin price tags $84.6K as US stocks head higher on SpaceX Q3 earnings beat
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin extended gains to approach $85,000 after US stock markets reacted to higher-than-expected SpaceX earnings.

cryptoNews.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
cryptoNews.summary: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

aiNews.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
aiNews.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

aiNews.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
aiNews.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

aiNews.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
aiNews.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

aiNews.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
aiNews.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO

aiNews.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
